verdict.rationale: Pomelo is an API-first card-issuing platform, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versioning, version identifiers, changelogs, or a deprecation or sunset policy. The cited docs cover product features and an MCP server only, so absence of evidence for this applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
